body: This issue should be caused by LOG(FATAL) concurrently in multiple threads..

```
1546 [ts-2] ==1446634==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free on address 0x611000080755 at pc 0x7f4ed6878297 bp 0x7f4ec0fa0770 sp 0x7f4ec0fa0768
1547 [ts-2] READ of size 1 at 0x611000080755 thread T24 (TabletServer_re) 
```
@Huqicheng Thanks! Since you've investigated this far, any chance you can push through a fix as well and take the other issue from @es1024 ?
@Huqicheng Option 2 seems cheaper, if the lock is always quick (eg: just get or set the state). Maybe try it out and put a small diff up with Eric & Sergei for review
